comments: f4e0550e: Prints a heading explaining that this section shows the number of days cases are pending.
66d46f2c: Formats the date in a specific format and stores it in DGJTX, then prints DGJTX and kills the variable.
5992dea5: If this is not the first physician, it calls the HDR subroutine to print a header line.
85bfdeeb: Loops through each physician, calling RET if needed, then prints a header and loops through each patient for that physician, calling PHY1 for each patient.
d9033edb: Returns from the PHY subroutine.
31afb61a: Loops through each patient and report for that physician and patient, setting DGJTDL, checking if the record exists, calling PRT2 if so, and calling PH^DGJOTP3.
f99c65c3: If this is not the first service, it calls the HDR subroutine to print a header line.
54391559: Loops through each service, calling RET if needed, then prints a header and loops through each specialty for that service, calling HDR3 and SER1 for each specialty.
bb84569b: Loops through each patient for that specialty and service, calling SER2 for each patient.
bdc36be3: Returns from the SER1 subroutine.
9f38bda4: Loops through each patient and report for that specialty, service, and patient, setting DGJTDL, checking if the record exists, calling PRT2 if so, and calling SV^DGJOTP3.
148c7327: Get the entry from the VAS (Virtual Author System) file.
1e6c6308: If not printing the Physician file, get the provider's name from the New Person file.
2201b8d3: For Physician file, print the Patient's name.
6a2ee525: For Service file, print the Patient's name.
e214f15f: Print the Date/Time of the entry.
d8fcb99b: Print the Provider's name for Service file.
2f5a622b: Clear the remaining lines on the screen.
ce6f67ad: Check if a new page is needed and print the header.
